claim: Construct the concrete native sp4 contact grading and faithful full-matrix derivation action; sharpen covariant curvature vanishing to its exact centrality criterion; exhibit flat noncommuting connection values and nonzero central curvature; separately check the exact supplied finite graph. The human interpretation remains distinct from kernel proof evidence.

carrier.type: Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ and its native skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra omega; generic DerivationLieLane R A for the centrality criterion; an independent fifteen-constructor Node partial order.
operations: Ordered full matrix multiplication and native Lie bracket
Native ad(H) eigenspaces and internal graded direct sum
Existing low-degree Chevalley-Eilenberg differential and curvature
Reflexive transitive closure of exactly the supplied predecessor relation
conventions: Lean matrix indices are zero-based; E14 means Matrix.single 0 3 1.
Directions act by inner derivations, so curvature of Γ_c(X)=cX is c(c+1)[X,Y].
Internal Lie degree and differential-form degree are distinct.

theorem covariantDerivative_commutator (Γ : OneForm K) (x y : K.L) (a : A) : covariantDerivative K Γ x (covariantDerivative K Γ y a) - covariantDerivative K Γ y (covariantDerivative K Γ x a) - covariantDerivative K Γ ⁅x, y⁆ a = connectionCurvature K Γ x y * a - a * connectionCurvature K Γ x y
owner_declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem covariantDerivative_commutator
    (Γ : OneForm K) (x y : K.L) (a : A) :
    covariantDerivative K Γ x (covariantDerivative K Γ y a) -
        covariantDerivative K Γ y (covariantDerivative K Γ x a) -
          covariantDerivative K Γ ⁅x, y⁆ a =
      connectionCurvature K Γ x y * a -
        a * connectionCurvature K Γ x y := by

smallest_gap.lean_signature: theorem covariant_commutator_zero_iff_central (Γ : OneForm K) (x y : K.L) : (∀ a : A, covariantDerivative K Γ x (covariantDerivative K Γ y a) - covariantDerivative K Γ y (covariantDerivative K Γ x a) - covariantDerivative K Γ ⁅x, y⁆ a = 0) ↔ ∀ a : A, Commute (connectionCurvature K Γ x y) a
